_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Material Cure-Date Certification Report
summary: The Material Cure-Date Certification Report provides the contracting agency the cure date marked on supplies lots/batches of contract line items to identify remaining shelf life.
description_purpose: The Material Cure-Date Certification Report will provide the contracting agency the cure date marked on supplies lots/batches of contract line items. The contracting agency will use the cure-date information to identify the shelf life remaining on items received in the supply system.
application_interrelationship: 3.1 This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instruction for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Document.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices and revisions shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Material Cure-Date Certification Report shall be presented in a format similar to that of Figure 1. It shall display the contractor's quality assurance or other responsible official signature.

children.title: The contracting agency's contract/purchase order number.
The National Stock Number (NSN) of each contract line item supplied.
The material lot/batch number supplied for each NSN.
The cure date marked on the item shall be identified and shall be in accordance with MIL-STD-129 for each lot/batch of each contract line item.
The report shall specify the items shipping destination(s) (e.g., Naval Supply Center, Norfolk or "N00189") and the quantity of the lot/batch shipped to each destination.
